note: Series 2 continues Series 1 numbering: base cards #351-700 (350 cards) with 52 RCs, plus four rookie short prints sharing #697-700 (McGonigle, Wetherholt, Benge, Crawford). Real One and 1952 Variation autographs are numbered by base card number; other autograph groups use letter prefixes. Parallels and non-autograph inserts/relics are omitted.
